updates.title: Verstappen and Antonelli trade the lead late in Las Vegas
updates.body: Verstappen edged back ahead after another Antonelli attack on Lap 41. Lando Norris was third and Oscar Piastri fifth on Lap 42.

updates.title: Antonelli challenges Verstappen for the lead
updates.body: Kimi Antonelli worked past George Russell and briefly led before Max Verstappen retook the position at Turn 1.

updates.title: Racing resumes after the safety car
updates.body: Verstappen led Russell and Isack Hadjar at the restart.

updates.title: Safety car follows Pérez and Câmara incident
updates.body: The safety car was deployed after Sergio Pérez and Rafael Câmara made contact. Pérez retired.

updates.title: Verstappen stays ahead at lights out
updates.body: Max Verstappen held the lead from pole as George Russell followed him through the opening corners.

updates.title: Verstappen and Russell share the front row
updates.body: The FIA confirmed pole for Max Verstappen and sixth on the grid for qualifying pacesetter Kimi Antonelli after his five-place penalty.
